Jane — looping you in to lock the stage and clarify costing triggers so we can keep Q4 forecasting clean. This thread is the official record for QuantaHealth (DEAL-20261012-QUANTA-01).

Quick context:
- You're at "Contracting" in our forecast; finance asked that we confirm any open commercial asks that could move this to commit by 10/19.
- We need explicit confirmation on: final PO timing, any required audit evidence, and a signed SOW addendum (if applicable).

Immediate asks (please reply inline):
1) Can procurement confirm target PO submission date?
2) Any new security evidence required beyond SOC2 in our portal?
3) Are there internal cost-approval thresholds that would delay sign-off? (e.g., $500k+ requires X)

Attached: Quanta-health-MAP-20261012.xlsx (pricing map) and stage-locklist-20261012.pdf (checklist). I’ve also attached a condensed stage-lock checklist you can forward to your approvers.

Plan: if we don’t get a PO date by 10/16, we’ll place deal into the RED list for the week-of 10/19 commit review and run a short save-plan cadence.

Thanks — Soojin

Thanks Soojin — quick answers inline below.

> 1) Can procurement confirm target PO submission date?
We are aiming for 10/20 to submit to finance. Internal approver calendar is tight the week of 10/19. I will confirm by 10/14 if we can move that earlier.

> 2) Any new security evidence required beyond SOC2 in our portal?
Not at present; security asked for a short note on data retention and access controls (we’ll draft). We can use your SOC2 link.

> 3) Are there internal cost-approval thresholds that would delay sign-off?
Yes — anything above $400k needs C-level approval and an extra 7–10 business days for procurement to finalize. The current TCV is at $385k, so we’re just under. If pricing shifts we’ll need to flag it.

I’ll confirm the PO timing by Thursday. Attaching a short internal note we circulated.

—Jane

IF PO date > 10/16 -> move to RED for weekly commit sweep.

Costing triggers (suggested auto-flags):
- >= $400k TCV -> finance approval required (auto-flag YELLOW)
- Pricing concessions > 10% -> escalation to RevOps + special discount code (auto-flag YELLOW)
- Any SOW addendum requested -> needs COUNTERSIGN timeline (auto-flag RED if > 5 business days)

- Soojin/Ben: if Jane’s PO slips past 10/16, we run the save-plan playbook and schedule a 15-minute triage with Quanta procurement.
